    print("sympy", sympy.__version__)
except Exception as e:
    print("no sympy:", e)

for i,line in enumerate(open('pairs.txt')):
    p,c=map(int,line.split())
    print(i, f"p={p:016X} c={c:016X}", "xor", f"{p^c:016X}")
    if i>=7: break
PY
